name: audit
description: Durable, bounded audit log other extensions record privileged actions into

retention.description: How many of the newest events the log keeps (default 100000); older events are pruned as new ones arrive. Read on every activation, so removing the key returns to the default.

authoring.description: Durable, bounded audit log. It serves no routes: other extensions record into it (store collections that declare audit: true) and operators read it with urlcode-audit list. The project declares only how many events it keeps.

surfaces.name: retention
surfaces.description: Newest events kept (1000..10000000, default 100000); older ones are pruned as new ones arrive.

agent.description: Local, revision-pinned references for agents configuring or consuming the audit extension.

references.name: audit extension guide
references.description: Configuration, the producer contract and the query API; ends with the generated field reference for every configuration key.

references.name: audit delivery guarantee
references.description: Atomic capture, at-least-once delivery stored once, fail closed at the backlog cap.
